name: Equity Derivative 3 Choice
definition: Element to define an equity instrument underlying code types.

Basket.name: Basket
Basket.definition: Populated when sub asset class is either swaps or portfolio swaps and the underlying type is a basket.

Index.name: Index
Index.definition: Populated when the sub asset class is either swap or portfolio swap and the underlying type is an index.

SingleName.name: Single Name
SingleName.definition: Populated when sub asset class is either swaps or portfolio swaps and the underlying type is a single name.

Other.name: Other
Other.definition: Populated when the sub asset class is neither swaps nor portfolio swaps.
